subject: Vendr scheduled maintenance & service-account rotation
messages:
From: Vendr Portal <portal-support@vendr.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: Morgan Blake <morgan.blake@cloudserv.co>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduled maintenance: temporary service-account rotation (June 23)

Hi Sean,

Heads up — our engineering team has a planned maintenance window on June 23 (UTC 03:00–07:00) to rotate a cluster of temporary service accounts used for API uploads. During the rotation a subset of delegated S3 presign keys and ephemeral tokens will be invalidated for up to 10 minutes per region while new keys are promoted.

We run this maintenance quarterly and try to minimize customer impact; most integrations see no downtime, but customers using long-lived presigns or pinned service accounts may need to reissue credentials.

Can you confirm whether CloudServe has any pinned Vendr service accounts for the profile linked to Brightleaf/CloudServe? If so, please share a short CSV with the account ids and the contact owning rotation (example attached).

Attachments: vendr-maintenance-notice.pdf (PDF) — short maintenance bulletin

If June 23 is a problem for you, tell us a preferred low-impact window and we can shift to the 24th (same UTC window).

Thanks,
Karen Patel
Vendr Portal Ops
portal-support@vendr.com

Vendr Portal — support and operational notices

Thanks Karen — appreciate the heads up.

Monica / Rishi — looping you in. Monica, CloudServe (Morgan) is our Brightleaf contact; can you confirm whether we have any pinned Vendr service accounts for their profile that would be impacted? If we do, please populate the CSV Karen attached (cloudserve-service-account-list.csv) and note the internal owner for each account.

Rishi — if the maintenance triggers any compliance evidence requests (CAIQ crosswalks, SOC 2 evidence of key rotation), can you advise what we should ask Vendr to produce and whether we need a short attestation before/after the rotation?

Karen — if we can get the CSV and a short CAIQ mapping template up-front that lists which CAIQ control(s) the rotation addresses, that will help us satisfy customer auditors quickly. We can accept DocuSign confirmations for attestation.

Proposed timeline (internal):
- Jun 9: confirm pinned accounts + owner mapping
- Jun 11: security/CS signoff on window and evidence commitments
- Jun 23: rotation (or Jun 24 if we shift)

Sean
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the tag. A couple of things from security/compliance: 

1) Evidence we will need (pre/post rotation):
   - A short statement from Vendr confirming the rotation scope and exact timestamps (UTC) with service-account ids impacted (PDF or DocuSign).
   - CAIQ mapping (spreadsheet) that maps the rotation to specific CSA CAIQ control IDs (e.g., IAM-2, SEF-3) so we can close the related auditor question.
   - If any presign urls are reissued as part of the rotation, a manifest of reissued URL ids and TTLs.

2) Timing: Jun 23 works for us provided we get the pre-rotation attestation by Jun 11 EOD and the post-rotation confirmation within 48 hours. If Vendr cannot provide that cadence, request we move to Jun 24.

3) Access model during rotation: we need to confirm whether the rotation affects:
   - Delegated S3 presign keys (short downtime risk)
   - Service-account API client-secret rotation (may require tenant-level reauth)

Karen / Vendr team — can you send the CAIQ mapping template (I attached a minimal example) and confirm you can produce a signed attestation pre/post rotation? If the attestation comes via DocuSign, include the envelope link in your reply.

Monica — please prepare the CSV with any pinned accounts by EOD Jun 11 and include internal owner. If CloudServe needs us to run any quick smoke tests, let Morgan know the expected test calls and sample tokens.

Rishi Malhotra
Security & Trust — Redwood Inference

Vendr — attaching the CSV and CAIQ mapping. We can accept DocuSign attestation for pre/post rotation; please send the envelope link and the pre-rotation signed PDF no later than Jun 11 23:59 PT (we are flexible on timezone but need it before EOD).

I added a short test plan below for Morgan to run after your rotation (simple GET to /health and a sample presign PUT test with TTL=120s). If you want us to run the smoke tests, schedule a 15-minute window for the post-rotation verification.

- 3) Verify reissued presign ids against manifest Vendr provides

Next steps:
- Vendr: provide pre-rotation attestation (DocuSign link) by Jun 11 EOD
- Vendr: confirm final rotation timestamp and provide manifest within 48 hours post-rotation
- Sean/Rishi/Monica: monitor smoke tests and close out evidence package to CloudServe

Thanks — Monica
